messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert: escalation policy 'Inference - Production' triggered. Alert: high 5xx error rate on inference-gateway-usw2. incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/1706006006
pagerduty: auto-page fired to @maria (primary), @josh (secondary)
maria: Acked. I'm on it. Opening runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
josh: seeing a 502 surge from kvcache upstream in us-west2. p50 looks fine, p95 and error-rate spiking. quick log sample:
```
2024-04-12T03:22:45Z inference-gateway request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 backend=kvcache-12 error="short read"
2024-04-12T03:22:46Z inference-gateway request_id=abc124 upstream_status=502 backend=kvcache-14 error="timeout"
```
sam: any recent deploys to kvcache or gateway?
irene: no deploys in last 6h, only a small canary earlier that didn't touch kvcache. no infra ops.
maria: ok. mitigation plan: shift 25% of traffic off us-west2 -> us-east1 and scale kvcache pool +2 nodes. @ops-bot please run route-weight change.
ops-bot: /run route-adjust --service inference-gateway --from us-west2 --to us-east1 --percent 25
ops-bot: success: route-change-id=rc-17060061
josh: running quick curl health checks against us-west2 endpoint: 502 -> 502 -> 200 after shift started.
maria: errors trending down: 5xx rate 4.2% -> 0.9% in last 7m. customer impact: some streaming sessions dropped (~140 req/min at peak). support notified.
irene: @support FYI: 1) degraded inference responses in us-west2; 2) partial mitigation applied (25% reroute + scale up); 3) next status update in 15m.
sam: watching autoscaler and eviction metrics for kvcache. will report if nodes fail to come up.
maria: propose to keep reroute for 60m TTL then slowly revert weights. agree?
josh: agree. setting TTL on rc-17060061 -> 3600s.
ops-bot: TTL set for route-change rc-17060061 (3600s)
maria: marking PagerDuty incident resolved, continuing monitoring. will open postmortem if recurrence. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident 1706006006 acknowledged and resolved by maria. link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/1706006006
maria: follow-up action: suspected kvcache eviction storm plus degraded backend nodes; assigning to infra (sam + josh) for deeper investigation and metrics.
sam: collecting heap profiles, eviction rates, and kernel OOM logs.
maria: closing thread—thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
